sections.heading: Objective 1: Autonomous Customer Service Agent
bullets: We rebuilt our supervised drafting assistant into a multi-agent system that reasons over live order and customer data and proposes concrete actions (exchanges, refunds, shipping edits) rather than draft text alone, with a safety layer that freezes unshipped orders before any change is applied.

We put our draft-vs-final judging instrument into continuous operation, which measures how often the AI draft is sent unchanged: June scored 67.7% (294 drafts judged) against a pre-project baseline of 64.7%, the primary yardstick toward the 80% autonomous-resolution target.

We launched a shadow-mode auto-send experiment on June 11 with a deliberately narrow gate (one low-risk reply category, hardcoded to never touch money or orders) to measure the would-have-erred rate before enabling any real autonomy, with 3 drafts marked would-have-sent in June.

We built an intent-routing and escalation layer that classifies incoming tickets, auto-holds orders needing changes, and routes malformed or low-confidence model output to a human, with founder handling time measured at 12.8 hours in June (roughly 3.0 hours/week).

sections.heading: Objective 1: Platform Reliability Under Load
bullets: We investigated why enforced structured output from the AI provider was failing under heavy load, tracing intermittent overload errors and slow responses to large-prompt requests demanding strict output formats.

We built an automatic fallback that switches drafts to a simpler output format when recent overload errors are detected, plus a fail-fast path that recovers a stalled response and its staged action, and validated both in production.

sections.heading: Objective 2: Partner Channel Discovery and Onboarding
bullets: We extended our early prospect-scraping and scoring prototypes into a staged discovery pipeline that triages a backlog of unprocessed prospects with a cheap first-pass model, then runs full research on the survivors, yielding 41 qualified prospects and 144 community organizations.

We built an automated outreach engine with AI-drafted personalized messages, multi-touch follow-up cadence, reply correlation, and a tiered work queue, kept hard-gated off by default so no messages send until quality is validated.
We built and published a public store-locator map of retail partners and seeded relationship records for 12 live partner organizations as the foundation for onboarding automation.

sections.heading: Objective 3: Growth Intelligence
bullets: We began a traffic-and-conversion intelligence initiative that pulls Google Analytics data into a queryable warehouse, an early step toward the unified ingestion pipeline needed for cross-source synthesis.
We built an email-marketing reporting feed and a weekly content-and-SEO summary loop, extending the standalone reporting scripts that existed at project start.
